import sys

def read_int():
    return int(sys.stdin.readline())

def read_ints():
    return list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

def read_vector(n):
    return [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()]

def write_int(x):
    print(x)

def write_vector(v):
    print(' '.join(map(str, v)))

def solve():
    n = read_int()
    arr = read_vector(n)
    arr.sort()
    
    t = read_int()
    
    left = 0
    right = 0
    max_len = 0
    
    while right < n:
        while right < n and arr[right] - arr[left] <= t:
            right += 1
        max_len = max(max_len, right - left)
        left += 1
    
    write_int(max_len)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
